Demand Draft shall be sent to "Assistant Purchase Officer-III, Indore Regional Purchase Unit, RRCAT, Indore - 452013 (M.P.) in a sealed envelope super scribing boldly Bid Number and Due date preferably by Speed Post or drop in IRP U Tender Box kept at Guard House, RRCAT, Indore. b) In addition to EMD/Bid Security exemption applicable as per GeM GTC, the following categories of Bidde rs also be exempted from furnishing EMD/Bid Security: i) DPS registered valid Bidders: Such Bidders shall have to upload scanned copy of relevant registration
